## Historical audit — H0002, chunk 2 of 3

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-baseline-run/runs/baseline_ds1017_claudecode_a1_20261120_r1/infer_logs/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/turn_1/trajs.json`. Event references below are to `main_agent` in that file; character ranges are half-open. Only the supplied chunk is visible.

| Area | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Goal | **Inferred:** implement recursive `delegate_task` handling in a multi-agent chat flow, including feedback and error cases. The visible text is the student’s interpretation and design, not the original task statement (event 104 [0,26834); event 113 [0,28903)). |
| Actual changes | Successful edits added a tool-use ID to provider responses and propagated Claude Code IDs (events 115–118). The handler gained delegation parsing and stream-message helpers (events 120–121), then recursive agent execution, feedback, error and cycle handling (events 129–130). Later successful edits preserved the parent session and reused resolved registry entries (events 161–172). An additional defensive-stream edit was **requested** at event 177 [0,1307); its result is not visible. |
| Validation | Existing handler tests reported 6 passed and 1 failed on abort-controller cleanup (event 135 [0,5031)). A stashed baseline run reported the same failure; the changes were then restored (events 137–138). Type-check output reported a missing `./version.ts` module, not a clean check (events 132, 134, 140–141). A student-authored mocked delegation suite initially passed 5/6, then passed 6/6 after its placeholder test was changed to consume the stream (events 144–159). These local tests do not establish full correctness. |
| Exploration | The student independently reasoned about provider, registry, stream format and hypothetical hidden tests (events 104 and 113), inspected backend types (events 111–112), and compared the failing test with baseline. A broad filesystem search timed out and moved to background; the attempted stop returned exit 144, so its final state is not established (events 105–109). A later test command failed because its relative working directory was wrong; an absolute-path rerun succeeded (events 155–159). |
| Teacher input | No teacher message or delivered hint is visible in this chunk. Metadata lists a captured-system-prompt archive path, but availability alone does not establish what the student received or adopted. |
| Outcome | Inventory metadata reports **partial correctness, formally not solved**: 2/7 fail-to-pass and 31/31 pass-to-pass checks. The evaluation file itself is not shown here, so the individual failures and their causes remain unknown. A nonempty patch is recorded in metadata, and edits are directly visible; this is not an empty-patch case. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferable observations are the value of matching tool-use/result IDs, exercising error paths, and comparing a regression against baseline. The exact stream shape, session behavior and registry integration are task-specific. The student’s hidden-test expectations and explanations of timing are hypotheses, not independent results. Whether the final defensive edit landed, what happened in the unseen chunks, and why formal checks failed are unresolved. This is a code trace, not a Scene task; object, material, pose and render checks do not apply.
